annotations.text:
Starter prototypes — dark editorial direction.

Photographs are greyscale stand-ins for yours (city hero, portrait, macro accent). Card thumbnails are drawn diagrams, not screenshots.

Only Tronk is a real project of yours — Ledger, Fieldnote and Scheduler are stand-ins so the grid shows four cards. The Tronk write-up is drafted prose, not your history.

Anything in [BRACKETS] is a hole for you to fill.
